Cuban President Accuses US of Seeking to Seize Island

The Cuban President, Miguel Diaz-Canel, accused the United States of seeking to seize the island. The US maintains that Cuba poses a security threat to the region and violates its citizens' rights. The US has been applying economic pressure on Cuba since January. The country is currently experiencing one of its worst economic crises. The Cuban government denies any intention to surrender its sovereignty.
